source_title: World's largest copper mine halts operations after worker death
quote: Operations at the world's largest copper mine, BHP's Escondida mine in Chile, were suspended on Wednesday after a worker was killed in an accident, the firm said.

source_title: World's largest copper mine halts operations after worker death
quote: BHP said the worker had been killed while carrying out maintenance work.

source_title: World's largest copper mine halts operations after worker death
quote: "All operational activities at the mine have been suspended," BHP said in a statement, without giving a timeline for when they may restart.

source_title: World's largest copper mine halts operations after worker death
quote: Typically in Chile, mines may only kick off activities after a fatal incident once inspectors verify that conditions are safe enough for a restart.

source_title: World's largest copper mine halts operations after worker death
quote: BHP operates the mine, while Rio Tinto holds a 30% stake and Japan-based JECO Corp 12.5%.

source_title: World's largest copper mine halts operations after worker death
quote: BHP had estimated the site would produce up to 1.28 million metric tons of the red metal this year.

source_title: Unions call strike vote at Antofagasta copper mine in Chile
quote: Two unions representing workers at Antofagasta Minerals' (LON: ANTO) Centinela copper mine in Chile called on workers to hold a strike vote, saying negotiations with the firm had reached a "dead end".

quote: Aster Chemicals and Energy has lifted the force majeure previously declared on its ethylene cracker complex in Singapore.

source_title: Aster Chemicals lifts force majeure on Singapore cracker complex
